title: The 7 Best Robot Lawn Mowers for Small Yards in 2026
h1: The 7 Best Robot Lawn Mowers for Small Yards in 2026
metaDescription: Our 7 picks for robot lawn mowers for small yards in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at robot lawn mowers for small yards in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 115H
products.blurb: Key specs: 0.4-acre (17,000 sq ft) coverage, Boundary wire guidance, 2 to 3.6-inch cutting height range.
strengths: Lowest-priced entry point into the Husqvarna Automower lineup
Simple, well-documented boundary wire installation for straightforward lots
Runs quietly enough to mow at night without disturbing neighbors
Long track record and wide dealer network for parts and service
limitations: 0.4-acre ceiling means it won't scale if you add more lawn later
Boundary wire installation is more labor upfront than wire-free models
Fewer multi-zone options than the higher-end Automower tiers

products.name: Worx Landroid M (WR147)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-acre (10,890 sq ft) coverage, AIA narrow-passage navigation, 20V Power Share battery.
strengths: AIA algorithm handles narrow side-yard passages and tight corners well
Power Share battery is shared with other Worx yard tools
Noticeably lower price than premium GPS-based competitors
Floating blade disc reduces scalping on slightly uneven ground
limitations: Still requires boundary wire for the main perimeter
Some owners report needing multiple resets during initial setup
Smaller coverage ceiling than the Automower 115H
features: Floating blade disc for uneven terrain
